description: The plugin catalogue (docs/design/recipe-plugins.md, slice 3b). `plugins` is exactly what the worker publishes (worker/tests/test_plugin_catalogue.py, catalogue_rows); `settings` are recipe `with` values the API's check (apps/api/test/plugins.test.ts) must accept or refuse against the plugin's settingsSchema, `error` a substring of its message.

plugins.summary: Fill fields or a table from the step's sections with regular expressions; no model call.

settingsSchema.description: Fill a field step's fields, or a table step's rows, by matching regular expressions in the step's sections.

patterns.description: For a field step: field id to regular expression. The value is the group named value, else group 1, else the whole match.
patterns.title: Patterns

row.description: For a table step: one regular expression per row; its named groups are column ids.
row.title: Row pattern

settingsSchema.title: Pattern settings

settings.name: no settings (the worker asks for patterns at run time)
a pattern that is not text
